notes.title: Demolish & Build 3 is now LIVE! 🥳💥🏗️
notes.content:
🏗️ Hello there, constructors
[hr][/hr]
Today the gates of our construction site swing wide open, and thousands of demolishers from all over the world begin their hard, rewarding work! From this very moment, you can get behind the controls of powerful construction machines, grab and use a variety of amazing tools 🔨 or browse engaging assignments from your customers. 

In fact, you can run your business any way you like because...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/ef99259102ec537601b75ca547d3eb14085e18bc.png

Demolish & Build 3 is now officially LIVE on Steam! 🥳
[hr][/hr]
We simply can't wait to hear about your first demolish adventures and building experiences. Will you be able to complete the challenging missions? Which vehicles will you buy first? Will you specialize in destruction or construction? In D&B3, you create your own path to success, which can be achieved in many different ways! 

Such a joyous event as the release of D&B3 could not do without a new Trailer, wouldn’t you agree? Be sure to check it out before you get to work, as the Release Trailer showcases some interesting challenges that you will have to deal with 💪 We hope you will like it!


Demolish & Build 3 Release Trailer 🎬
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=GcGIebRv3Y4;full][/previewyoutube]

Before you go... 🚧
[hr][/hr]
Today's release of our title is also a great opportunity to express our gratitude for your unwavering enthusiasm, continued support and patience. Together we've managed to create a wonderful, vibrant community, full of great people who share a passion for thrilling, immersive demolition 💥

Remember that we are still at your disposal and that we are always happy to answer your questions, suggestions and feedback 📜 We carefully analyze and note down every single voice and opinion, so keep them coming, ok? Cool! 

We will do our best to improve and update D&B3 based on your reviews, so that it constantly evolves to become an even better, more refined title. After all, there's nothing we can't achieve as a team, right builders? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/fec8b8a4e7470b40a47cd501b5ac1047affdbde4.gif

All right now, everyone! It's time to get to work 👷‍♂️
[hr][/hr]
We don't want to hold you back any longer. Go now, demolishers, and prove your skills on the construction site. There are many challenges, interesting assignments and long hours of fun ahead, so put your hard hats on and jump straight into the action 🕹️ Have fun and see you soon!

notes.title: Demolish & Build 3 Prologue is now ready to play for free!
notes.content:
The wait is over🏗️

Demolish & Build 3 Prologue
is now ready to play for free on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2803230/Demolish__Build_3_Prologue/

Gear up and prepare for the job with our Trailer:
[previewyoutube=x5cV7m8rwSc;full][/previewyoutube]
Support the main release, Follow Demolish & Build 3 and add us to your Wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670/Demolish__Build_3/
Thanks! The more the Wishlist and Follow the better discounts we can give at full game launch and later!

The release date of Demolish & Build 3 on PC (Steam) is set for Q2 2024. 

In 2025, the game will also be available on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.


Demolish & Build 3 is a new installment of the construction and demolition owner company simulator series.

The gameplay focuses primarily on performing various demolition and construction works,             as well as developing and managing a business.

We are preparing, among others, a realistic destruction system.

Each fragment consists of a specific material with specific parameters of resistance to various types of damage. Even greater realism is ensured by taking into account the interaction of individual objects and structures.

InDemolish & Build 3 Prologue, you take your first steps into making a construction company by learning the ropes and operating hand tools, demolition hammer, and heavy machines on the job site. Do the job and earn your pay.

Demolish & Build 3 Prologue will include the first few missions from the main release and features mostly but not only:

🚧 Vehicle controls based on real construction machines,
🚧 Physics-based track mechanics,
🚧 Large excavator,
🚧 Skid steer,
🚧 Specialized attachments for both vehicles,
🚧 Controller support,
🚧 Fully destructible objects and structures,
🚧 Third-person and first-person camera modes,

The main game will bring in the future:

🏗️Running and growing the company,
🏗️Randomly generated missions,
🏗️Varied locations,
🏗️Languages translations,
🏗️More tools and machines,

Join the crew on Discord or follow our channels for updates:
Discord: https://discord.gg/qJSWEk3vWs

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100069086002960

X: https://twitter.com/DemolishGames

Yours faithfully,
Demolish Games S.A. “Demolish & Build 3” Team.

notes.title: Demolish & Build 3
notes.content:
IT'S OFFICIAL! 
Meet Demolish & Build 3!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670/Demolish__Build_3/

Demolition & Build 3 is a first person simulation game in which the player becomes the owner of a demolition company. Your main tasks involve demolishing and building various structures and managing your company. To help you with those tasks you can use various tools and vehicles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29659157/56c2a087f9a02ac09d891d9f77cf2c3ff128e5bb.jpg

NEW PHYSICS
Demolish & Build 3 uses a brand new, realistic destruction model. Every fragment is physically simulated. Different parts of the structures interact with each which means that for example a few strategically placed explosives can collapse an entire building. Our destruction model provides a perfect balance between realism, performance and fun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29659157/f49a2c72b37a8fc02b1e05f82992f93e99cda77f.jpg

NEW COMPANY MANAGEMENT
You’ll start the game with a small plot of land and a simple shack. By the end you’ll build an empire with multiple vehicle parks and offices.
Company management will include features like:

hiring workers
buying tools and vehicles
buying land
building your own offices
managing finances
managing your workers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29659157/c6f30dbf4c626229aa3d7bd3c211c57543fc10c1.jpg

NEW VEHICLES
Throughout the game you can use a variety of vehicles, all with detailed models and sounds. Each vehicle can be driven from the cabin as well as from the outside. Some vehicles, like the excavator will also include several different attachments like shears or jackhammers to help you with your tasks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29659157/2a65df70a8d7c98eaab7b04fe16ba1f96f6026e2.jpg
